chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Suwayd, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh; and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī together, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAlī ibn Suwayd.

key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ: the intermediary narrator from whom the report is transmitted
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ: the source narrator to whom this chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Suwayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Suwayd. It serves as a chain-authentication notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and the named transmitter.
